text:
In 2018, Lahore had **0.178 million acres** of land classified as built area, making up **42.5%** of the district's classified land (the classification covers 99.9% of Lahore's total land area).

This is from the **Land Classification** section of the portal. For context, crops were the most widespread class at 53.1%, and built area was the second-largest class.
